svg.title: ST-70 chassis underside — all five signal paths plus mains
svg.desc: Underside (wiring-side) view of the ST-70 chassis with components placed per the original Dynaco wiring pictorial. Front panel at top, rear panel at bottom. All five signal paths are overlaid in distinct colors using strictly horizontal/vertical wire segments. The mains-side wiring (cord, fuse, switch, PA-060 primary) is shown in a separate dark color.
svg.text: ST-70 chassis underside — all five signal paths
Wiring-side view (front panel at top); component positions per the original Dynaco pictorial; orthogonal routing for clarity.

g.data-tooltip:
V4 — LEFT BIASET SOCKET.
Octal socket on the front panel; no tube. Meter-probe point for the left channel bias. V3 cathode-sense voltage arrives here via step 33. Target reading: 1.56 V.
LEFT RCA INPUT JACK — audio signal input for the left channel. Center pin = signal; shell = ground.

INPUT AREA — multi-position level switch + 1 MΩ grid leak resistors (one per channel) on a small terminal strip.
The switch selects between line and other input modes; the grid leak gives each input a high-impedance DC reference to ground.
RIGHT RCA INPUT JACK — audio signal input for the right channel.
V5 — RIGHT BIASET SOCKET. Same as V4 but for the right channel. V6 cathode-sense arrives here via step 36.

V3 — LEFT EL34 (upper).
• Pin 3: plate → A-470 GREEN lead • Pin 4: screen → A-470 GRN/WHT (UL tap, sampled for HF feedback) • Pin 5: grid (from PC-3A eyelet 2) • Pin 8: cathode → 15.6 Ω sense resistor → V4 Biaset • Pins 2, 7: heater (daisied with V2)
Paths through V3: Audio, B+, Heater, Bias, Feedback (UL tap)

V2 — LEFT EL34 (lower).
• Pin 3: plate → A-470 BLUE lead • Pin 4: screen → A-470 BLU/WHT (UL tap) • Pin 5: grid (from PC-3A eyelet 1) • Pin 8: cathode (daisied with V3, then to V4 Biaset) • Pins 2, 7: heater (green pair from PA-060)
Paths through V2: Audio, B+, Heater, Bias

V6 — RIGHT EL34 (upper).
• Pin 3: plate → A-470 GREEN lead • Pin 4: screen → A-470 GRN/WHT (UL tap, sampled for HF feedback) • Pin 5: grid (from PC-3A eyelet 23) • Pin 8: cathode → V5 Biaset (via step 36) • Pins 2, 7: heater (daisied with V7)
Paths: Audio, B+, Heater, Bias, Feedback (UL tap)

V7 — RIGHT EL34 (lower).
• Pin 3: plate → A-470 BLUE lead • Pin 5: grid (from PC-3A eyelet 22) • Pins 2, 7: heater (brown pair from PA-060)
Paths: Audio, B+, Heater, Bias

PC-3A DRIVER BOARD — the only printed circuit in the amp.
Mounted with 4 screws to the chassis underside. Components face UP (so the 6GH8A driver tubes stand upward like the other tubes); solder pads and 23 numbered eyelets face DOWN toward the wiring side.
Per channel: pentode (gain ~50×) → coupling cap → triode (cathodyne phase splitter) → 2 outputs (180° apart) to the EL34 grids.
The PENTODE CATHODE on each channel is the FEEDBACK SUMMING NODE — both feedback wires (main loop from 16 Ω, HF comp from UL tap) terminate there.
Paths: Audio, B+ (in), Heater (in), Bias (out to pots), Feedback (returns)
g.text: mounted with 4 screws · 23 numbered eyelets · 2× 6GH8A on top

g.data-tooltip:
SEVEN-LUG TERMINAL STRIP — bias filter network + heater CT ground.
• Lug 4: first bias filter node (~−70 V) — 1N4007 anode lands here + 100 µF cap • Lug 3: second bias filter node (~−60 V) — clean bias rail to pots + 100 µF cap • Lug 2: divider return (10 kΩ to ground) • Lug 1 / lug 6: ground (heater CTs ground here too)
Paths: Heater (CT ground), Bias.
g.text: bias filter network + heater CT ground

g.data-tooltip:
V1 — 5AR4 RECTIFIER TUBE.
• Pins 4, 6: plates (red HV leads from PA-060) • Pin 8: cathode + heater. DC output to filter cap lug 2. • Pins 2, 8: heater (5 V from PA-060 white pair)
Paths: B+ (source), Heater.

QUAD FILTER CAP — four sections (lugs 1, 2, 3, 4) sharing a common ground.
• Lug 2: ~435 V (raw rectified, input to choke) • Lug 1: ~415 V (after choke — main B+, to OPT primary CTs) • Lug 4: ~375 V (after 6.8 kΩ — pentode screens + triode plates) • Lug 3: ~305 V (after 22 kΩ — pentode plate load)
Both dropping resistors (6.8 kΩ, 22 kΩ) live on this cap chassis.
Paths: B+ (entire cascade).

1N4007 BIAS DIODE — half-wave rectifier on a small 2-lug terminal strip.
Cathode (banded end) faces the PA-060 bias winding; anode goes to 7-lug strip lug 4. The reverse orientation is what produces NEGATIVE DC at the bias rail.
Paths: Bias.

BIAS POTS — adjustable voltage dividers between the bias rail and the divider return.
Each pot's wiper drives one EL34 grid via the 1 kΩ grid stopper at the socket. Stock ST-70: 2 pots (one per channel). Individual-bias-pots mod: 4 pots (one per tube).
Paths: Bias.

A-470 LEFT OUTPUT TRANSFORMER.
PRIMARY (5 leads, exits TOP toward V2/V3): • BLUE → V2 pin 3 (plate) • GREEN → V3 pin 3 (plate) • RED → primary center tap → filter cap lug 1 (B+) • BLU/WHT → V2 pin 4 (UL screen tap) • GRN/WHT → V3 pin 4 (UL screen tap + feedback sample)
SECONDARY (4 leads, exits BOTTOM toward speaker strip): • BLACK (common), BROWN (4 Ω), ORANGE (8 Ω), YELLOW (16 Ω + feedback sample)
Mounted on TOP of the chassis; body extends UP. From the wiring side you see its mounting bolts and the leads coming through grommets.
Paths: Audio, B+, Feedback.

PA-060 POWER TRANSFORMER — single source for every voltage in the amp.
SECONDARIES: • HV (red leads + red/yellow CT): ~720 Vpp AC → 5AR4 plates • 5 V (white pair): 5AR4 heater (V1 pins 2, 8) • 6.3 V × 2 (green + green/yellow CT for L channel; brown + brown/yellow CT for R channel) • Bias (red-black pair): ~70 Vpp → 1N4007
PRIMARY: BLACK and WHITE leads to the mains side (cord → fuse → switch).
Mounted on TOP of the chassis; the largest single component.
Paths: B+ (source), Heater (source), Bias (source), Mains.

CHOKE C-354 — ~1.5 H inductor.
Wired between filter cap lugs 2 and 1. With the cap on lug 1, forms the LC low-pass filter that removes essentially all of the 120 Hz ripple from the rectified DC.
Mounted on TOP of the chassis; smaller than the PA-060.
Paths: B+.

PRIMARY FUSE — in series with the PA-060 primary BLACK lead.
Mounted as a chassis-through fuse post on the rear panel. Protects against catastrophic shorts on the primary side.
Paths: Mains.

POWER SWITCH — interrupts the PA-060 primary path.
The anti-click cap modification goes across these contacts.
Paths: Mains.

A-470 RIGHT OUTPUT TRANSFORMER — mirror of the left.
Same color and connection scheme: BLUE → V7, GREEN → V6, RED CT → B+, BLU/WHT and GRN/WHT → V7/V6 screens (UL); secondary BLACK/BROWN/ORANGE/YELLOW → right speaker strip; YELLOW also sources the right channel's main feedback loop.
Paths: Audio, B+, Feedback.

LEFT 4-SCREW SPEAKER TERMINAL STRIP — landing point for the L A-470 secondary leads.
• Lug 4: BLACK (common, speaker −) • Lug 3: BROWN (4 Ω) • Lug 2: ORANGE (8 Ω) • Lug 1: YELLOW (16 Ω + main feedback sample for left channel)
Speaker wires attach here in final assembly.
Paths: Audio (out), Feedback (sample at lug 1).

POWER CORD + STRAIN-RELIEF GROMMET — 3-prong mains entry.
• BLACK (hot) → fuse → switch → PA-060 primary • WHITE (neutral) → PA-060 primary (direct) • GREEN (earth) → chassis ground (the 3-prong mod adds this)
Paths: Mains.

RIGHT 4-SCREW SPEAKER TERMINAL STRIP — mirror of left.
Paths: Audio (out), Feedback (sample at lug 1).
EARTH GROUND — green wire from 3-prong power cord ties to chassis ground. Part of the 3-prong cord safety modification.

svg.text: Every wire endpoint has a colored dot snapping to a component's edge. Wires are strictly orthogonal — actual physical leads curve and bundle differently.
Colored dots inside each component show which paths use it. See [signal-paths](../signal-paths/index.md) for the stage-by-stage trace of each path.
